name: agentops-eval-v1
description: Twenty short documents from a fictional developer platform (Helio Cloud), including look-alike distractors, and 44 questions: direct and paraphrased questions that the documents answer, and off-topic and near-miss questions that they do not.

questions.question: How much does the Pro plan cost per month?
gold_evidence: costs 29 dollars per month per workspace

questions.question: How many requests per minute does the Team plan allow?
gold_evidence: Team allows 3000 requests per minute

questions.question: How many times does Helio retry a failed payment?
gold_evidence: retries the charge 3 times over 7 days

questions.question: How long do refresh tokens last?
gold_evidence: Refresh tokens expire after 30 days of inactivity

questions.question: What HTTP status does the API return when the rate limit is exceeded?
gold_evidence: receive HTTP status 429

questions.question: Which regions can I choose for my data?
gold_evidence: US East in Virginia or EU West in Frankfurt

questions.question: How long are request logs kept on the Team plan?
gold_evidence: 30 days on Team

questions.question: What is the maximum webhook payload size?
gold_evidence: The maximum webhook payload is 256 KB

questions.question: How many times are failed webhook deliveries retried?
gold_evidence: retried 5 times with exponential backoff

questions.question: What prefix do production API keys start with?
gold_evidence: starts with the prefix hk_live_ for production

questions.question: What is the uptime SLA for Enterprise workspaces?
gold_evidence: Enterprise workspaces by 99.99 percent

questions.question: On which day and time is scheduled maintenance performed?
gold_evidence: Maintenance windows are on Sundays between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC

questions.question: How long is the free trial for Pro and Team?
gold_evidence: 14-day free trial

questions.question: How many members can a Team workspace have?
gold_evidence: up to 10 members
10 on Team

questions.question: Who can pay by ACH bank transfer?
gold_evidence: available on Team and Enterprise only

questions.question: How long after a P1 incident does Helio publish a postmortem?
gold_evidence: publishes a postmortem within 5 business days

questions.question: What do I get if my 99.9% uptime guarantee is missed slightly?
gold_evidence: credit of 10 percent of that month's fee

questions.question: How soon do I need to ask for compensation after an outage?
gold_evidence: Credits must be requested within 30 days

questions.question: If I stop paying, what happens to my projects?
gold_evidence: downgraded to the Free plan

questions.question: Can a person who left the company still use the keys they made?
gold_evidence: Removing a member does not revoke the keys they created

questions.question: Which hosting locations are offered for customer data?
gold_evidence: US East in Virginia or EU West in Frankfurt

questions.question: How quickly does a deleted key stop working?
gold_evidence: revoked keys stop working within 60 seconds

questions.question: What do I do if my server answers slowly to Helio's event notifications?
gold_evidence: answer with a 2xx status within 10 seconds

questions.question: How much advance notice do customers get before planned downtime?
gold_evidence: announced at least 7 days in advance
